name: Ring sweep versus fixed pulse, EEG probe (trial timing after Wang 2019)
origin: Trial structure after Wang et al. 2019 (Caltech: Kirschvink, Shimojo; University of Tokyo: Matani); the ring version is a project construct
summary: Six runs of about 7 min, each with 162 pseudorandom trials 2 to 3 s apart: in a sweep trial a 100-ms field pulse travels once around the eight-coil ring (12.5 ms per coil), in a fixed trial it stays on the front coil (Fpz). The trial timing follows Wang 2019; the stimulus does not. Wang turned the direction of a uniform 35 uT field at constant strength, which this helmet cannot do. Meant for EEG (alpha, 8 to 13 Hz).
notes: Wang 2019 sat people in a dark, shielded chamber and rotated the direction of a uniform field between two preset orientations, with its strength held nearly constant at the ambient lab value of about 35 uT (p.5; p.9). Trials were 2 to 3 s apart in runs of about 7 min (p.5, p.9). Runs had 127 trials (63 fixed, 64 sweeps) or 150 (50 per rotation, 50 fixed), up to eight runs per session (p.9). They reported an alpha-power drop after one rotation type only (downward-directed, counter-clockwise). This program keeps the trial timing only. It switches a local field on for 100 ms and moves it round the ring with a linear crossfade: a change of strength at each coil, which is what Wang's design excluded. A fixed trial is a 100-ms pulse on Fpz; in Wang it is no change at all. Each run has 162 trials (81 sweeps, 81 fixed): its own 135-s pseudorandom block (27 sweep, 27 fixed, at most 3 of a kind in a row) played three times. A phase holds only two tracks, so the direction is fixed per run: runs 1, 3 and 5 sweep counter-clockwise seen from above (Fpz, F7, T7 ...), runs 2, 4 and 6 clockwise. Trial onsets are the tables' full-scale points (100 ms each) counted from the start of the run; an EEG analysis needs them as markers. Fades are off, and the 1-min rests are this project's choice. Wang's field was about 35 uT, uniform around the person. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. 35 uT against 5 uT is a factor of 7 (4 at the helmet's maximum), but the number means little because the two stimuli differ in kind. Wang's result comes from one lab and no independent replication was found; expect a null result. Wang's double-wrapped sham coils are left out: the app's Blind option switches the current off, so its sham does not reproduce current-related artefacts. Check for induced EEG artefacts on a saline phantom. A real replication needs a three-axis coil system around the whole head.
setting: Seated, eyes closed, in total darkness and quiet, with EEG (alpha 8-13 Hz, analysed after sweep versus fixed trials). Wang's participants sat in a dark, shielded chamber; sessions took about 1 h.
schedule: One session per sitting; no repetition schedule was part of the original study.
source: Wang et al. 2019, eNeuro, Transduction of the geomagnetic field as evidenced from alpha-band activity in the human brain https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6494972/
